pairing: same workload / namespace mode / block; fresh process per build; seeded shuffled workload and build order
statistic: geometric mean of paired block-median time ratios; percentile paired bootstrap 10000 resamples, seed 20260913
ordinaryGate: 95% CI upper bound <= 1.02 for every protected case
positiveGate: >=5% E2E attribute-heavy public workload improvement plus actual XML guards OR >=3% broader full-accessor geometric mean, without protected regression
variants: H1B only if H1A establishes span-comparison blocker
seriesPurpose: crossover diagnostic, never substitutes actual XML guards
instrumentation: separate untimed build; never used for performance comparisons
extensions: none; stop after fixed evidence budget; no post-hoc threshold tuning
secondaryRuntime: Bun and Deno correctness/performance smokes only after Node survival
cold: report fresh import and constructor separately; large regression is a cost
